description: A single filled area drawn as steps, so each value holds until the next reading.
overview: One series with `type="step"`, which draws flat runs between readings instead of a slope. Use it for values that change at discrete moments, such as prices or plan limits. It has a month axis, a dashed grid and a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Set the label and color in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
